mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and may increase renal sodium/water loss via chlorthalidone, while chlorthalidone can cause hyponatremia and hypokalemia that may lower seizure threshold.
action: Monitor electrolytes (sodium, potassium), blood pressure, and seizure control; adjust chlorthalidone dose if needed and ensure adequate potassium supplementation.
